brief: Renters and pet insurance starting at about $5 a month, all by app. Looking for new renters and pet owners who just got a pet.

profile.business_summary: App-based provider of renters and pet insurance starting at $5 a month, targeting new renters and recent pet adopters.
stated_claims: Renters and pet insurance starting at about $5 a month
profile.fulfillment_notes: Insurance services delivered digitally via mobile application.

relevant_tags.why: Core category for pet insurance offering.
Insurance is billed on a monthly recurring subscription model.
App-based management appeals to convenience-oriented consumers.
Shoppers buying pet supplies are pet owners who may need pet insurance.
Renters insurance is directly related to home and living spaces.

note_signals.why: Health-conscious pet owners are highly aligned with pet health insurance.
Largest pet audience in the catalog provides excellent scale for pet insurance.

profile.gate_reason: The product, pricing model, and target audiences (renters and pet owners) are clearly defined and map well to our publisher network.

pricing.rationale: Pay per click (verifiable without trusting a pixel). Market price to win a page view on these hosts: $0.59-$0.79 per click (median $0.68), from the simulated auction against the other campaigns. 'balanced' bidding tries to win up to 60% of each host's page views; the planned bid per host is the price that wins its planned share.
